title: The Fall of Teng City
summary: Teng Huayuan sends the four remaining core members, including Teng Ba with his Blazing Sky Nine Feathers, to hold Wang Lin off for the time it takes an incense stick to burn, and Wang Lin kills them all. Teng Bo, a ninth-generation disciple, rallies the Teng cultivators into a bloodline formation, but Wang Lin shatters it with the divine sense of the dead core members, then breaks the God-Piercing Sword, a Soul Formation-grade weapon the envoy gave Teng Huayuan. Face to face, Teng Huayuan says he wiped out the Wang family because Wang Lin killed his descendant Teng Li, and Wang Lin swears to destroy the Teng clan's foundation before his eyes. Teng Huayuan then reveals that the incense was for a Reversal Formation that sacrifices the city and the Teng bloodline, Teng Bo included, gathering the whole clan's divine sense into a force equal to Soul Formation that cancels Wang Lin's lightning. Wang Lin counters with leftover Soul Formation poison that destroys the souls of the weaker cultivators, and closes in on Teng Huayuan as a voice orders him to stop.
